verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's main visual, the diamond photo mosaic. It survives only as one small rectangular photo plus an empty wireframe of diamond outlines in the top right, and the headline divider rule is left orphaned under that grid. Body copy is tiny and floats unaligned, and the vertical URL is cramped against it. In A the date diamond almost touches the photo's right edge. B leaves cleaner gaps between the photo and the date diamond, so it is marginally better, though its body copy sits further from the headline and crowds the URL.
